tips.text: Repeat Roathe from the Infernum 21 checkpoint, then buy the last one or two missing pieces with Maphica.
Do not abort or die on a floor between checkpoints; the only checkpoints are Infernum 7, 14 and 21, and you can lose that run's Maphica.
Farm Uriel's mats in the same Perita Rebellion runs; he needs a lot more of the same three resources.
Expect the blueprints to be quick; the long part is the Perita Rebellion runs for Agnovidisc, Laudavi and Servoris.
